premise: A summer shower: a cloud drifts over, pitter-patter on the lagoon, plip-plop on the big flat rock, everyone shivers and then laughs and dances in the warm rain, and when it stops a rainbow arches over the far red cliffs — until somebody shakes their tail.
inspiration: The weather-turn of folk tales (the storm that brings the gift), made small and sunny: the shower is the fun, the rainbow the gift.
lesson: A rainy day can be a happy day.

en-US.title: Rain in the Valley
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.6} A big soft cloud came drifting over the valley. Plip. {all:face surprised} One drop, right on somebody's nose. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} And down came the summer rain. Pitter-patter on the lagoon. Plip-plop on the big flat rock. Tip-tap on the fronds of the tree fern. {all:shake} Everyone shivered, brrr! And then {all:face happy} {all:wobble} everyone laughed, because summer rain is warm! [excited] So they {all:hop x2} hopped in it. They {all:spin} twirled in it. They opened their mouths {all:pulse} and caught it, plip, on the tongue. Even the sleepy old mountain far away was having a wash. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:clouds stop} Then, as quick as it came, the rain stopped. {sfx:drip solo} {all:face surprised} Quiet. {canvas:rainbow} And over the far red cliffs, a rainbow stretched across the sky. [in awe] {all:face happy} {all:sparkle} Everyone stood very still and looked. [playfully] Then somebody shook their tail, and somebody shook their wings, {all:face surprised} {all:spray} and everyone got wet all over again. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} What a lovely, soggy day!

es-ES.title: Llueve en el valle
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.6} Una nube grande y blandita pasó sobre el valle. Plic. {all:face surprised} Una gota, justo en la nariz de alguien. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Y empezó la lluvia de verano. Plic, ploc en la laguna. Tic, tac en la gran roca plana. Tip, tap en las hojas del helecho gigante. {all:shake} Todos tiritaron: ¡brrr! Y luego {all:face happy} {all:wobble} todos se echaron a reír, ¡porque la lluvia de verano es calentita! [excited] Así que {all:hop x2} saltaron bajo la lluvia. {all:spin} Dieron vueltas bajo la lluvia. Abrieron la boca {all:pulse} y la cazaron al vuelo: ¡plic, en la lengua! Hasta la vieja montaña dormida, allá lejos, se estaba dando un baño. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:clouds stop} Y, tan deprisa como había llegado, la lluvia paró. {sfx:drip solo} {all:face surprised} Silencio. {canvas:rainbow} Y sobre los riscos rojos, a lo lejos, apareció un arcoíris. [in awe] {all:face happy} {all:sparkle} Todos se quedaron muy quietos, mirándolo. [playfully] Hasta que alguien sacudió la cola, y alguien sacudió las alas, {all:face surprised} {all:spray} y todos acabaron empapados otra vez. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} ¡Qué día tan pasado por agua!

rain.prompt: a warm summer shower falling on a calm lake, grass and big leaves, realistic field recording

drip.prompt: the last slow drips falling from leaves after rain, two or three soft drops, quiet, realistic
